domains.title: Industrial Automation
domains.summary: PLC-based control and monitoring treated as a first-class engineering discipline: digital and analog I/O, pulse counting, Modbus registers, timers, alarms and remote supervision.
focus: Modbus / Modbus TCP register handling (signed, unsigned, 16- and 32-bit)
Threshold logic, process timers and machine states

domains.title: IoT and Edge Computing
domains.summary: Edge devices that keep working through connectivity loss: local logic, buffering, MQTT messaging and controlled edge-to-cloud transfer over Ethernet, Wi-Fi or cellular links.
focus: Raspberry Pi, Compute Module 4, RP2040, Pico W, ESP32-S3
Cellular modems: NB-IoT, LTE-M, AT commands, APN setup

domains.title: Full-Stack Development
domains.summary: Mobile-first, offline-first web applications and the services behind them: local transaction queues, API synchronisation, audit logging, exports and printed records.
focus: Progressive Web Apps with offline sync queues
Node.js and Node-RED services and REST APIs
Frappe / ERPNext custom apps, DocTypes and print formats
Thermal receipts, QR codes, CSV and Excel exports

domains.title: AI and Agent Systems
domains.summary: Practical AI in engineering work: multi-agent development workflows with defined roles and approval gates, local LLM experiments, tool calling and automation pipelines.
focus: Multi-agent software development with role definitions

domains.title: Cloud Infrastructure
domains.summary: Hosting and operating the services that field systems report to: Linux servers, reverse proxies, TLS, DNS, containers and service management.
focus: AWS EC2 and Linux VPS deployment
SSH key authentication and service hardening

domains.title: Security Technology
domains.summary: Software integration for physical security operations: checkpoint and visitor workflows, IP cameras, vehicle recognition and event notifications. Integration work, not a certified security service.
focus: Security checkpoint and visitor registration apps
IP camera integration (RTSP streams, camera APIs, OSD overlays)

domains.title: GPS and Telematics
domains.summary: Turning vehicle telemetry into operational intelligence for transport, security and logistics: live position, trips, geofences, driver behaviour and scheduled reporting.
focus: Trip history, route replay and scheduled reports

domains.title: Real-Time Visualization
domains.summary: Interfaces that turn telemetry into decisions: Grafana and custom dashboards, alarm feeds, historical trends and physical LED displays driven by live data.
focus: Custom real-time web dashboards over WebSockets and MQTT
HUB75 LED matrix displays for process values
